_schema.about: Render-only sector border + Guild Lane markers (art batch C, sectors design 2026-10-18 §2.3, §5.2). glTF axes: +Y up, origin = anchor on the gameplay plane. No collision, no sim state.
_schema.markerFrame: The border runs along the marker local Z axis (glTF): fence_l sits at -Z, fence_r at +Z (see fenceL/fenceR). Local +X faces INTO the sector whose security the marker shows. Orient each instance so +X points into that sector and -Z points along the border in the direction of the next marker (fence_l(i) -> fence_r(i+1)).
_schema.fences: fence_l / fence_r are EMPTIES at the emitter tips (their local +X points outward along the border). Draw the light fence from marker i fence_l to marker i+1 fence_r (a camera-facing ribbon with border_fence_<security>.png, additive, tinted by color, u along the border, repeat every fenceRepeat units).
_schema.glow: glow_<i> EMPTIES = lamp centres for an additive halo sprite (vfx/glow_soft.png, size glowSize, lamp colour): at distance 140 the lamps are 1-2 px, the halo keeps the border readable.
_schema.lamps: beacon_<i> = lamp MESH nodes (clone the material, animate emissiveIntensity) - same as the station/trader beacons; the per-security rhythm is in lamps.
_schema.spacing: Guild border / Rust markers every spacing units along the sector boundary (organic spline, never a circle); only where the boundary is within ~600 u of the camera. jitter = random offset along the border and yaw wobble per instance (deterministic hash of the position).
_schema.colors: color = the UI token (src/ui/theme/tokens.css) for the security level - use the same value for fences, ribbon and halo tints so the world matches the map legend (sectors §5.1).

lamps.beacon_0: steady slow pulse 0.5 Hz (both ends in phase)

guarded.look: Guild pylon: navy/orange float, light column, crossbar with two green emitter pods, Cech emblem on the crossbar top (reads from above)

lamps.beacon_0: very slow breathing 0.25 Hz, low intensity (calm)

quiet.look: small grey float, slim mast, horizontal halo ring with a pale blue-grey lamp

lamps.beacon_0: irregular flicker (hash-based on/off 40-120 ms), mostly on

contested.look: the Guild pylon faded, scorched, leaning 7 deg, -Y crossbar half snapped with a hanging cable, one amber lamp left

pirate.look: "Hrdzavé značky / Rust markers": welded scrap totem, girder spine, spiked crossbar, claw crown around a red lamp; Banner_<clan> = clan cloth + emblem on both faces + a clan-colour crown cap on the top (the top-down clan read). Show exactly ONE banner (clan owning the pirate sector; unknown clan -> rust).

placement.fenceHeightNote: fence emitters sit ~1.5-2.6 u above the anchor; ships fly at y 0, so the fence runs just above them
placement.whichMarker: Place the marker of the sector being ENTERED on each side: along a boundary between A and B put A-markers facing A and B-markers facing B, alternating, or only the more dangerous side (Pirate > Contested > Guarded > Quiet). Spec §5.2: Guild buoys on Guarded borders, Rust markers on Pirate borders; Quiet / Contested markers are optional extras.

ribbon.notes: soft volumetric haze band lying in the plane (or a low vertical curtain) along the boundary spline; v across (core at v 0.5, no hard edges), u along. Tint with the security color; scroll u slowly (0.02/s) so it breathes.

fenceStyle.guarded: evenly spaced solid dashes (= solid fill on the map)
fenceStyle.contested: irregular broken dashes (flicker by scrolling u)

laneBuoy.frame: +X = along the Guild Lane, AWAY from home (the orange arrowhead points that way)
laneBuoy.placement: on the lane centre line every 120-160 u (the player flying the lane always sees 1-2), plus optional pairs on the corridor edges (+-250 u) every 200 u at the same arc length; lamp beacon_0 amber, chase blink along the lane: phase = index * 0.25 s (a slow "runway" sweep outward), period 2 s, on-time 0.35 s
laneBuoy.links: link_fwd / link_back EMPTIES on the halo ring: optional faint dashed line to the next buoy (border_fence_guarded.png tinted lane color)

picket.notes: checkpoint post at Guarded sector entrances / on Guild Lanes (C3). Local frame like station_layouts.json (+X = dock direction, +Y = left, grid units). dock_port at (R, 0, 0) for a future dockable variant - no arm/cradle yet. Picket_Dish spins around +Y (glTF, 0.25 rev/s), Turret_0 yaws (rest aim +X), strobes alternate. If it collides, the sim needs a copy of circles.
